messages:
sasha: Quick check — I need to debug a recurring 500 on /generate in prod. Runbook mentions not exposing user inputs in logs. What are the minimal safe steps to take before I request ephemeral access?

jamal: Short checklist: 1) try to reproduce in staging with synthetic inputs, 2) if you must access prod logs, request ephemeral role (prod-readonly) via ITREQ, 3) use the redact-tool before copying anything out, 4) follow runbook section 4.2 for approvals.

priya: If you need a one-liner to strip obvious PII locally, use something like:```bash
# fetch (role-based tool) and redact locally
rlogs fetch --service inference --since 1h > /tmp/logs.txt
./tools/redact-logs --patterns 'email,ssn,creditcard,Bearer' < /tmp/logs.txt > /tmp/logs.redacted
head -n 200 /tmp/logs.redacted
```That script masks common tokens. If you don't have redact-logs, a quick sed example:```bash
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g; s/[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}/[REDACTED_SSN]/g' /tmp/logs.txt > /tmp/logs.redacted
```Only share the redacted file.

sasha: Good — I don't have redact-logs installed on my laptop. Can I run the fetch+redact on the bastion and then copy the redacted file out? What's the approved flow?

jamal: Yes but two things: 1) request ephemeral session via ITREQ and specify you need bastion+prod-readonly, 2) ask the oncall approver to run the redact step in the bastion if you don't want to install tools locally. Prefer the approver-run option for faster compliance.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Please attach ITREQ ticket ID to the session request. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/prod-debug#access-requests :lock:

ava: Quick security note — do NOT paste raw request/response bodies with user text into public channels. Even redacted snippets must be validated: if redaction is heuristic, run a secondary check. For emergency exceptions, escalate to sec-oncall and include a justification (what, why, how long).

priya: Also FYI — when debugging model inputs, try input-sampling: reproduce the issue via a 10x smaller synthetic set and attach the repro steps. That avoids any user data exposure and helps debugging.

sasha: OK will open ITREQ-84219 with details: need access to logs for service=inference, since=2h, will request approver to run redact step in bastion. I'll ping here once approved. Thanks! :pray:

ava: Approved pattern: include the ticket ID + one-line risk statement. Example: 'ITREQ-84219: read-only logs for /generate 500 investigation; no PHI expected; will not export raw user text; will use redact-tool or approver-run.' Keep that in the ticket to speed approvals.

jamal: One last ops tip — if you end up needing a heap/profile dump, get an explicit sec signoff. Those often contain sensitive in-memory data.

sasha: Noted. I'll follow the flow and report back with sanitized findings. Thanks everyone.
